title: Negative: a third trophic level built the same way (a conserved top-predator material condensed only by digesting predator material) does not make a food chain of three dividing kinds; the top predators take over every prey, the predators drop below threshold inside them, and the whole population freezes
summary: world3.py adds to the digestion-driven predator world (20261027T0325-c52-digestion-ecology-claim) a top-predator material c, conserved and miscible on its own, that condenses only up its own product s2 made by digesting predator material (dig2 = k3 c_b^nb3 c_c^2; predator material -> waste, remade into predator material at gb everywhere) and drifts up the predators' digestion product q (chiQ 0.5); it is added as noise at t=4000. Labkit 128^2 seed 0, t=10000-12000: within ~700 t the top predators condense on every prey (41-47 bodies, 41-47 persistent tracks) and the predator bodies disappear (45 -> 0); with nb3 2, 3 or 4, kd3 400 or 1500, mc -0.9 or -0.95 the result is the same. Inside the top bodies (w3_c, last frame) the predator material is still present below the body threshold (c_b 0.23, max 0.79, against 0.07 outside) and still digests prey (q 0.42), and the top predator digests it (s2 0.55): a static three-layer composite. The population freezes: 0 top splits, 6-7 prey persistent splits, against 5 predator and 17 prey splits in the two-level world at the same size and seed.

finding.operator: third trophic level of digestion-driven condensation (conserved top material condensed only up its own product of digesting the level below, nonreciprocal taxis up the lower level's product)
finding.control: two-level world at the same size and seed (pack128 of the parent claim's world)
finding.result: top 41-47 persistent bodies, 0 splits; predator bodies 45 -> 0; prey splits 6-7 vs 17; predator material held at c_b 0.23 inside top bodies

limits: One seed, 128^2, five parameter points; the top predator sits on the prey because it drifts up q, which is made where predators digest prey; a top predator with a weaker taxis, slower digestion (k3 << 0.02) or a refuge for predators was not tried.
